item.text:
The commands in [README.md](/sanitized/tmp/google-dev-standards-eval.root-03/codex/N2-firebase-readme/workspace/README.md:3) are valid, but the setup instructions leave several decisions implicit:

- **Add prerequisites:** The npm installation requires Node.js and npm. Link to the [Firebase CLI documentation](https://firebase.google.com/docs/cli) for current version requirements.
- **Explain initialization:** Tell readers to create or select a Firebase project they can access, then select the Firebase products they intend to configure during `firebase init`. The command creates `firebase.json` and `.firebaserc` locally.
- **Clarify deployment:** `firebase deploy` deploys all configured deployable resources to the active project. Recommend checking the selected project and configuration first; `firebase deploy --only <service>` can limit the deployment. The [CLI reference](https://firebase.google.com/docs/cli) documents both behaviors.
- **State the repository’s scope:** This repository currently contains no Firebase configuration or application files. The README should explain what readers are expected to set up and deploy; otherwise, they cannot tell which products to select or what content to provide.
- **Keep the key guidance:** “Never commit service account keys” is useful. Clarify that interactive `firebase login` authenticates with a Google account and does not require a service account key.
